description: Source code implementing the patience diff algorithm in C, part of the LibXDiff library, including data structures, algorithms for finding longest common sequences, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: struct hashmap
classes.description: Hash map structure used for matching lines between files in the patience diff algorithm.

methods.name: is_anchor
methods.description: Checks if a line matches any of the anchor patterns defined in the xpparam_t structure.

methods.name: insert_record
methods.description: Inserts a line record into the hashmap, marking it as unique or non-unique.

methods.name: fill_hashmap
methods.description: Fills the hashmap with line records from both files for comparison.

methods.name: binary_search
methods.description: Performs binary search to find the position to insert a line in the sequence for longest common subsequence calculation.

methods.name: find_longest_common_sequence
methods.description: Finds the longest sequence of unique matching lines between two files.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if two lines from different files are identical based on their minimal perfect hash.

methods.name: walk_common_sequence
methods.description: Recursively walks through the common sequence of lines, extending matches and applying diff on unmatched regions.

methods.name: fall_back_to_classic_diff
methods.description: Uses the Myers algorithm as a fallback when no unique common sequence is found.

methods.name: patience_diff
methods.description: Main recursive function implementing the patience diff algorithm.

methods.name: xdl_do_patience_diff
methods.description: Public API function to perform patience diff on two files.
